hero.bio:
Software Development Engineer experienced in building scalable B2B, industrial, and IoT applications.
Proficient in distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and cloud-ready architectures using C# and TypeScript.
Passionate about performance optimization, maintainable design patterns, and delivering high-quality, reliable software.

projectDescriptions.iotAutomation: A lightweight React web application for controlling IoT devices, optimized to run directly from Arduino-based devices with RESTful APIs.
projectDescriptions.industrialDashboard: Web dashboard for monitoring and managing IoT devices in industrial environments, featuring real-time updates and data visualization.
projectDescriptions.whatsappBackend: Backend service integrating WhatsApp Business Cloud API with secure messaging, CQRS, and background processing via Hangfire.
projectDescriptions.tabletopGame: Fully playable board game built with C++ and Lua in the Tabletop Simulator editor, developed under tight deadlines.

description: Designed and implemented scalable RESTful APIs for B2B applications ensuring high performance and reliability.
Developed frontends with Angular and Vue.js with focus on responsive and user-friendly design.
Delivered cross-platform mobile apps with Ionic Angular ensuring consistent functionality.
Deployed containerized applications with Docker, Portainer, and Traefik, and automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Workflows.
Optimized database queries for MySQL improving performance and scalability.
Built AI visual recognition systems using Python with Supervision, TorchVision, and YOLO for object detection and image analysis.
Developed a production-ready REST API integrating WhatsApp Business Cloud API for high-volume messaging.
Implemented CQRS architecture using MediatR with clean dependency injection and modular services.
Added WhatsApp Flow capabilities with encrypted request/response handling.
Managed background jobs with Hangfire backed by SQL Server ensuring reliability and fault tolerance.
Applied JWT authentication, rate limiting, and structured logging with Serilog.
Built B2B web applications using Node.js, SAPUI5, and React with PostgreSQL and Docker.
Delivered custom client solutions focusing on reliability, low latency, and high availability.
Managed on-premise deployments for testing, staging, and production environments.
Collaborated in agile teams applying design patterns for scalable architectures.
Contributed to a web application managing refrigeration units and cooling systems across facilities.
Worked across frontend and backend with JavaScript, Java, and Python.
